sources.notes: Confirms the Galaga-B4.1-260615-1653 release family. Region wording must not be used to replace the EEA fingerprint recorded by the diagnostic device.

sources.authority: OEM package distributed through Google Android OTA infrastructure
sources.notes: The URL token is not treated as a SHA-256 digest. The package must be downloaded by an authorized operator and hashed locally. Incremental reconstruction also requires the exact base build.

The community index states that OEM OTA links are direct official-server links and that partition images are extracted or reconstructed by its pipeline. Community-produced images remain third-party derived artifacts until independently reproduced and hashed.
